_comment: List prices used to MODEL cost per question. Nothing here was billed to us; every number is a published list price with its source URL. Change a price, re-run `node src/score.mjs`, and every cost column changes — no cost number is ever hand-written into a table.

model._note: Served locally on :8002, so our marginal cost is electricity. For a comparable-cost table we price it at a public hosted rate for an open model of this size. Whoever re-runs may substitute their own provider; the ratio between arms is unaffected because all arms use the same model.
model.source: PLACEHOLDER — set to the list price of the hosted provider you cite, and put the URL here before publishing.

graph._note: The Graph gateway bills per query against a query budget. Record the ACTUAL number of gateway queries the arm made (the MCP server issues one per executeQuery) and multiply.
graph.source: PLACEHOLDER — set from thegraph.com pricing before publishing; the runner records the query count either way.

knowledge._note: What arm C's knowledge costs once, from the anchor being tested. Filled in by the runner from the catalog entry (anchor.price + anchor.currency); a CREDIT price must be converted at a declared rate or the break-even chart is drawn in CREDIT.
